name: Star CM Holdings Limited
summary: Star CM Holdings Limited, founded in 2006 and headquartered in Shanghai, produces, operates and licenses variety program intellectual properties in China, the United Kingdom, the United States, Japan and other markets. Its content includes music, dance, talent and talk shows, and it also licenses music, film and drama IPs and hosts offline events. It offers artist management, arts education, concert production, apps and consumer products, and is involved in real estate development.
